notable_absence.finding: The page's own curl commands for creating the database/role/user use only Basic auth with the sync_gateway RBAC user's credentials - it never states which Couchbase Server RBAC role (e.g. Full Admin, as named in get-started-prepare.md) is actually required to call these Admin REST API endpoints; that requirement is implicit, carried over from Prepare rather than restated here.

cross_component_finding: This page's PUT/POST examples key documents by a compound keyspace path (`traveldb.inventory.hotel/hotel_88801`) while get-started-verify-install.md's equivalent examples (also in this batch) key the same conceptual document by the bare database name alone (`traveldb/hotel_88801`, with `_default`/`_default` implied) - reflecting the same configure/verify-vs-explore split noted in get-started-configure.json's cross_component_finding. Only this page's role and user JSON bodies nest access under `"collection_access": {"inventory": {"hotel": {...}}}`; get-started-verify-install.md's equivalent bodies use a literal, unresolved placeholder shape (`"scopename": {"collection_name" {...}`) that is not even valid JSON, suggesting get-started-verify-install.md predates the scopes/collections feature and was not fully updated when get-started-explore.md was introduced to replace it.
cross_product_finding: None found on this page specifically - it stays entirely within Sync Gateway/Couchbase Server scope (Couchbase Lite is mentioned only in a forward-pointing Next Steps link, not discussed).
